---

## How to fill this in honestly

- **Rate what you observed**, not how much you like someone. A quiet teammate
  who shipped three solid features scores high.
- **Be specific in the free text.** "Didn't contribute" is not usable. "No
  commits after 12 Oct, tickets #14 and #19 unmoved, did not respond in
  channel for a week" is.
- **Grade inflation hurts your team.** If everyone rates everyone 5, the form
  tells the mentor nothing and your own real contribution gets no weight.
- **This is one of six checks**, not the whole picture — commits, the board,
  standups, PRs reviewed, the contribution write-up, and the Demo Day defence
  all count too (standards/definition-of-done.md). You are not deciding
  anyone's fate on your own.
- **Raise serious problems before now.** If someone has not contributed for two
  weeks, the mentor should hear it at the time — not for the first time here,
  when it is too late to fix.
